content.gate_definition: The S-route window envelope (0274 g2-cut kernel shape, day078 e_win_s) is piece-linear in its per-piece S-difference constants: E_win_S = c1*W1 + c2*W2, c1 = Smax(t)+Smax(GLAST) [piece (gData, t-1]], c2 = Smax(t+1)+Smax(GLAST) [piece [t+1, ...]]; W1 = |f(gData)| + (f(gData)-f(t-1)) = 46.3914/46.4268/46.4521/46.4571, W2 = 2|f(t+1)| = 55.9417/56.0125/56.0631/56.0730 (sigma A/Q/F/N; pure kernel, 0274 values unchanged). The 0274(g) exclusion criterion fires iff E_win_S < fluc + fedge. Hence W(t) is CERTIFIED EMPTY at sigma iff a per-piece S-diff bound c <= cGate(sigma) = (fluc+fedge)/(W1+W2) holds at that height.

content.gate_statement: IF for every t >= tPT2 the unknown-side S-fluctuation obeys a per-piece S-difference c1(t) <= cGate and c2(t) <= cGate with cGate = 2.5821 (sigma_A) / 2.5805 (sigma_Q) / 2.5809 (sigma_F) / 2.5847 (sigma_N) (uniform in t - the tPT2 values, the profile being easier above), THEN E_win_S(t) < fluc(t) + fedge(t) at every t and every probed sigma - hence W(t) = (t-1, t+1] carries NO face zero at any t >= tPT2.
content.literature_status: Web search 2026-11-04 (S-diff / narrow-strip zero-count literature, 3 angles): NO published pointwise unit-scale S-difference bound below O(ln t). The pointwise |S(t)| bounds (Backlund family O((ln t)^c), e.g. O(ln t) under RH / O((ln t)^{22/31+...}) unconditional refinements) and the moment bounds for S(t+h)-S(t) at h ~ 1/ln t (small h) do NOT reach the unit-scale pointwise gate. The required cGate ~ 2.58 (tPT2, decreasing) is pair-correlation-strength input (unproven territory). The Titchmarsh 9.2 disc proof (Jensen on the sqrt(5) disk, N(T+1)-N(T) <= n(sqrt(5))) is the disk-route side - same class constant 81.191752 (Zeta23 witness, existential; see 0275).

Fleet (a) remains valuable for the count side and the 0263 census; it is not a route to the gate.
content.next_unit: 0277 = the mechanism unit (research): a proof technique delivering c <= cGate (pair-correlation-strength unit-scale S-diff, uniform in t >= tPT2) - e.g. a face-localized pair-correlation estimate for the unknown zeros against the known-side S-stream, or a new S-method with the face kernel.
